name: 12c-convert-xai-messages
description: convertXAIMessages (prompt-converters.js:785-814) and its three-rule table, one message per rule. The guard at :791-793 skips a message with no `name` and any `user`-role message (which is why the system and user turns at the end are untouched). For the rest, the table at :795-803 is searched in order and the FIRST match decides; the rule's `condition` is a tri-state value (falsy, or a boolean), and the reference's `find` tests it for truthiness, so a rule whose condition is `''`/`false` is skipped rather than matched. The prefix at :806 is `userName` only for the system+example_user pair, otherwise `charName`. The `delete msg.name` at :810 runs for EVERY message that reaches the body -- matching or not -- so a named assistant turn whose content is already prefixed still loses its `name`. That delete-not-just-on-match behaviour is the sharp signal here.
